response.overview: Chaos ensues as an unhoused woman is robbed by a beret-wearing knave (who is then attacked by an older woman engaging in vigilante justice). A cop attempts to apprehend them all (including the unhoused woman, for some reason; the cruelty of the American criminal justice system knows no bounds) at varying rates of success.
response.tagline: When the danger of the city calls... no one can refuse.
response.title: Hobo Money Gets Stolen
